releases.name: ARMSX3 for iOS 0.0.4 beta
releases.body:
## Graphics and memory

**Faster frame submission.** MoltenVK now turns each frame into Metal work on its own thread instead of on the graphics thread, so the graphics thread spends almost no time submitting a frame. Framebuffers are now freed only after the GPU has finished with them, which this needed. Thanks to RewindBox, whose work led to this.

**Freed textures give their memory back.** Large texture allocations now get memory of their own, which goes back to iOS when the texture is freed. Before, one texture still in use kept a whole 64 MB block, and One Piece held 2.3 GB of blocks for 643 MB of textures. Thanks to RewindBox, whose work led to this.

**Upload buffer space comes back sooner.** The texture upload buffer gives back finished space after every full GPU wait, where it held it until the next frame and swapped in a new buffer instead.

**No stall on the first new shader.** The shader compiler's one-time setup now happens at boot. It used to land in gameplay, on the first shader a game hadn't shown before. Thanks to RewindBox, whose work led to this.

**Black Ops II weapon.** The weapon in your hands no longer draws with its triangles over each other.

releases.name: ARMSX3 1.7.1
releases.body: # ARMSX3 1.7.1 ## Games - **Uncharted 2: Among Thieves, Super Street Fighter IV, Journey, and other games:** fixed the stop with "Failed to compile fragment shader" at the default Shader Precision (Low). - **Ratchet & Clank: Tools of Destruction:** fixed the freeze on Cobalia (thanks Seeslo for testing). -**Uncharted 3: Drake’s Deception** gets The Last of Us fix for freezes during play, since both games run the same job system, prevents freezes in UC3. ## Save states - **Save states from 1.7 and earlier don't load in 1.7.1,** because RPCS3's font module update changed the save state format. In-game saves are not affected.

releases.name: ARMSX3 1.7
releases.body: # ARMSX3 1.7 ## Highlights - **New SPU code compiles in the background.** Games keep running while it compiles, so new areas load without pausing. Games that need the old pause keep it. - **Compiled SPU code now carries over between updates,** including game updates, so first boots after them are quick. Each game compiles once more on its first boot after this update. ## The Last of Us - **Fixed the freeze during play.** The game hands its work to background jobs and waits for them, and on phones a job list could stop with work still in it, freezing the game anywhere from minutes to hours in. ARMSX3 now keeps those jobs moving.

releases.name: ARMSX3 for iOS 0.0.3 beta
releases.body:
## XMB mode

**The PS3's own menu.** ARMSX3 can now look and work like the PS3's XMB: the wave and sparkles, the boot, every column with its rows and settings, music with the Waves, Valley and Gaia visualizers, a video player, a photo viewer with slideshows, the XMB keyboard, and the in-game XMB with save states, Change Disc and Turn Off System. The icons, words, font and sounds come from your installed firmware, and a PS3 theme brings its own. Turn it on with the wave button in the library bar or in the last step of setup. On an iPhone it holds the screen in landscape, and while a game runs it lets go of its wave to leave the game more memory.

**Built-in Track and Turned off.** The Music column plays a built-in track, and Diagnostics lists a session you ended with Turn Off System as Turned off, where it said Closed by iOS.

## Black Ops III

releases.name: ARMSX3 for iOS 0.0.2 beta
releases.body:
Changes since 0.0.1. Thanks to everyone who sent problem reports, since most of these fixes came from them. This is a beta: the JIT changes ran on an iPhone, and everything else was tested on a Mac. Please send a report if something works worse than in 0.0.1.

## Requirements and install

ARMSX3 for iOS needs an iPhone or iPad with an A14 chip or newer, on iOS 17.4 or later. It isn't on the App Store, so install the IPA with SideStore, AltStore or LiveContainer. JIT needs a pairing file for your device (see Pairing files below).

## Update LiveContainer first

If you run ARMSX3 inside LiveContainer, update LiveContainer to 3.8.13 or later before you install this build. That is the nightly build at the moment: https://github.com/LiveContainer/LiveContainer/releases/tag/nightly Older versions can't load the JIT helper, and ARMSX3 will fall back to StikDebug.

In LiveContainer, turn on Helper Process Support for ARMSX3, and open ARMSX3 full screen, not in a window.

## Built-in JIT inside LiveContainer

armsx2-armsx3.latest_body:
## Graphics and memory

**Faster frame submission.** MoltenVK now turns each frame into Metal work on its own thread instead of on the graphics thread, so the graphics thread spends almost no time submitting a frame. Framebuffers are now freed only after the GPU has finished with them, which this needed. Thanks to RewindBox, whose work led to this.

**Freed textures give their memory back.** Large texture allocations now get memory of their own, which goes back to iOS when the texture is freed. Before, one texture still in use kept a whole 64 MB block, and One Piece held 2.3 GB of blocks for 643 MB of textures. Thanks to RewindBox, whose work led to this.

**Upload buffer space comes back sooner.** The texture upload buffer gives back finished space after every full GPU wait, where it held it until the next frame and swapped in a new buffer instead.

**No stall on the first new shader.** The shader compiler's one-time setup now happens at boot. It used to land in gameplay, on the first shader a game hadn't shown before. Thanks to RewindBox, whose work led to this.

**Black Ops II weapon.** The weapon in your hands no longer draws with its triangles over each other.

releases.name: Cemu 2.6
releases.body:
**Changelog:**
- Exporting saves via the title manager no longer crashes when the export path contains unicode characters
- Fixed a regression in DS Virtual Console titles (#1440)
- Fixed a bug where the debug shader dumping option would try to write files to the wrong directory
- Added a right-click context menu to the PPC debugger disassembly view and fixed some smaller bugs in the debugger
- Use libusb as the backend for HID/USB devices on Windows (#1471)
- Reduce amount of Vulkan sampler objects that are created. Reduces memory usage slightly and avoids crashes on drivers that have a low limit on sampler objects
- Improved index data caching on Vulkan. This may provide a very small performance benefit in some games
- The `--force-interpreter` command line option now always uses single-threaded CPU emulation like originally intended

releases.name: Cemu 2.5
releases.body:
**Changelog:**
- Upscaling and downscaling options in the graphics settings now work correctly on Vulkan. Previously, the hermite and bicubic scaling options would only work on OpenGL and silently fall back to bilinear filtering on Vulkan
- Graphic pack support for custom scaling shaders has been reworked and is now functional on Vulkan, with fixes carrying over to OpenGL. If you are a graphic pack developer see #1392 for details
- Cemu will now show an error if the MLC directory is not writeable
- Added a workaround for graphic driver crashes seen in the eShop versions of Fatal Frame. These are caused by the game shipping with shaders that contain infinite loops. The actual hardware has an escape mechanism for this that we don't yet emulate
- Added support for connecting Wiimotes via L2CAP on Linux (Details in #1353)
- Set correct version for MacOS bundle
- Updated Arabic, German, Russian and Swedish translations

releases.name: Cemu 2.4
releases.body:
**Changelog:**
- Added emulated Dimensions Toypad
- Fixed a corruption bug which could occur when reading from titles in .app/.wud/.wux format under rare circumstances
- Cemu will now validate all reads for .app/.wud/.wux format titles and log any detected errors to log.txt. In the future we will also show these errors on screen
- Reworked the Wii U error dialog implementation (ErrEula) for better accuracy. This should fix the bug where sometimes the error dialog was unskippable in some games
- Fixed a bug in the HLE implementation of proc_ui.ProcUIRegisterCallback/ProcUIRegisterBackgroundCallback

releases.name: Cemu 2.3
releases.body:
**Changelog:**
- Vulkan: Fixed a race condition where uniform data could get corrupted. Most commonly this would cause polygon corruptions in BotW or XCX but in theory could affect every game
- Vulkan: Changes to how frame display is handled to reduce input latency
- Input: Fixed a crash that could occur when closing the add controller dialog while a controller search was still active
- Amiibo: Fixed an issue where Amiibo were not detected in Mario Kart 8
- Online: SpotPass functionality now respects the proxy_server option in settings.xml
- Windows: In portable mode shortcut save icons will now be stored to the Cemu directory instead of %appdata%
- Misc: Fixed a crash that could occur when invalid command line parameters were passed to Cemu

releases.name: Cemu 2.2
releases.body:
**Changelog:**
- Handle null timeout in `nsysnet.select`. Fixes a crash in Skylanders SuperChargers and Imaginators
- Fixed an issue where changing the `Receive untested updates` option would have no effect
- The Linux appimage version will use the system `libstdc++.so.6` if it is newer than the bundled file
- Updated French, Korean and Simplified Chinese translations

releases.name: v0.4.8
releases.body:
# v0.4.8 主要更新

新增：视频实时翻译，识别视频或游戏正在播放的对白，以双语对照悬浮字幕显示原文和译文，没有原字幕也能使用。支持本地模型或在线识别，需要 Android 10 及以上版本。

新增：手势模式，支持八种手势分别绑定功能，并可通过点击主球、侧滑唤起、左右旋转或前后倾斜触发。

新增：快捷面板，集中显示六种模式、语言方向和四个快捷操作，支持横竖屏布局。

新增：本地模型管理，支持下载模型、导入 GGUF、独立保存模型参数，以及使用相同原文试译比较。

新增：Index-Translate、Qwen3、LFM2.5、Gemma 和 TranslateGemma 等本地模型选择。

新增：Root 和无障碍截屏，支持自动选择可用方式，也可手动切换截屏方式。

新增：「B站翻译(免费)」，内置服务配置，选择后即可联网使用，感谢bilibili的免费翻译服务。

新增：「PP-OCRv5 东斯拉夫语」模型，支持俄语、白俄罗斯语、乌克兰语和英语识别。

新增：开发者选项支持隐藏 OCR 置信度不足或未识别到有效文字时的红色提示。

新增：[Issue #31](https://github.com/ciddwd/overlay-translator/issues/31) 提出的阿拉伯语界面翻译，感谢 [Maxaseel](https://github.com/Maxaseel) 提供翻译。

优化：日漫 OCR 加速，**已下载旧版日漫模型的用户，可点击「补充下载」，在保持识别精度的同时加快识别，无需删除重下。** 同时优化 PaddleOCR 识别，减少重复识别和图案误识别，改善漫画原文擦除、背景修复及译文排版，减少残字、越界和排版拥挤。

优化：主页布局，更方便地查看预设、当前状态、截屏服务和批量翻译任务。

优化：悬浮球设置分组，将贴边、菜单按钮、触发方式和手势绑定分别整理到独立页面，统一模式切换提示。

优化：设置选择控件，统一选中块样式，增加滑动切换效果，并调整高度、边距与交互反馈。

优化：自动识别设置，使用语言卡片管理识别方式、模型选择和下载状态。

优化：初始化引导选择日文、韩文、俄语、白俄罗斯语、乌克兰语、中文或英文时会匹配对应 OCR；其它源语言默认推荐 PaddleOCR v5 mobile。

优化：相册图片导入与系统分享流程，改善批量翻译任务的创建和处理体验。

优化：模型下载进度、速度显示、失败恢复和就绪检查，整理语音模型下载状态展示；完善本地翻译模型的加载方式、旧配置迁移与资源释放。

优化：设置保存、预设管理、首页提示与词典交互，改善识别、屏幕旋转和循环翻译时的显示，减少配置丢失及使用过程中的崩溃。

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.17
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.17: más rendimiento

### Cambios

- **Más rendimiento en procesadores con 2 núcleos rápidos** (Helio G85/G88/G99, MT6769/MT6789 y similares). En la versión anterior dejamos de fijar los hilos del juego a los núcleos rápidos en estos procesadores, y en algunos volvió el lag. Ahora el hilo principal del juego, el que más trabaja, va en los núcleos rápidos, y los demás hilos los reparte Android. Con 4 o más núcleos rápidos no cambia nada: todos los hilos van en ellos.
- **Menos trabajo inútil en cada fotograma.** El juego pregunta por `d3d9.dll` en cada fotograma, y el port lo anotaba en el registro cada vez: unas 2000 líneas por segundo en Most Wanted y Carbon. Ahora se anota una sola vez. Otras líneas repetitivas (texturas convertidas en la CPU, entrada de teclado, liberación de superficies) también se limitan. Además de ahorrar CPU, el registro de los reportes conserva lo importante.
- **Cierres que dejaron de aparecer.** Con la versión anterior ya no hemos vuelto a ver el cierre más repetido de Most Wanted al arrancar, ni el de Underground 2 en la preparación de los reflejos. Si te vuelve a pasar, envía el reporte desde el launcher.

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.16
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.16: LAN sin bloqueos y reportes más completos

### Cambios

- **Crear carrera LAN ya no detiene el juego si tu `server.dll` es de otra versión.** Antes salía "Arranque guest detenido: server.dll: file layout does not match the lifted code" y el juego se paraba. Ahora aparece un aviso: ese teléfono no puede crear la carrera, pero sí unirse a una que cree otro jugador. Para crearla, copia el `server.dll` de la misma instalación de PC de donde sacaste el ejecutable del juego.
- **Rendimiento recuperado en procesadores con solo 2 núcleos rápidos** (Helio G85/G88, MT6769 y similares). Desde la versión anterior, todos los hilos del juego se fijaban a los núcleos rápidos. En estos procesadores eso los metía todos en solo 2 núcleos, y el juego iba peor que antes. Ahora solo se fijan cuando hay al menos 4 núcleos rápidos; si no, Android los reparte como antes.

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.15
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.15: driver recomendado para tu GPU

### Driver Vulkan recomendado para tu procesador

- **El launcher te dice qué driver usar.** En *Opciones › Driver Vulkan* ahora aparece la GPU de tu teléfono y el driver que le conviene:
  - **Snapdragon (Adreno 6xx/7xx):** Turnip (Mesa), si el driver del sistema va lento o con errores gráficos.
  - **MediaTek, Exynos, Tensor o Unisoc con Mali-G57 o más nueva:** PanVK (Mesa), con la misma condición.
  - **Mali-G52/G72/G76 o más antiguas:** el driver del sistema (PanVK aún es experimental en ellas).
  - **PowerVR (Moto g54, Helio G35/G37…) y Samsung Xclipse:** el driver del sistema. No hay un driver alternativo que funcione en ellas.
- **Aviso si el driver no es para tu GPU.** Si eliges un driver hecho para otra GPU (por ejemplo, Turnip en una Mali o PanVK en una Adreno), el launcher avisa de que el juego probablemente no arrancará.

La app no incluye ningún driver: los importas tú como ZIP (adrenotools) desde el mismo diálogo.

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.14
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.14: volver al juego sin cierres y reportes completos

Revisamos los reportes de la v0.1.13. La protección para GPU PowerVR funcionó: el Moto g54 ya pasa del primer dibujo. Esta versión corrige el cierre más repetido y hace que los reportes traigan la información que necesitamos.

### Correcciones

- **Cierre al volver al juego.** Si salías a otra app y volvías, el juego podía cerrarse en el primer fotograma. Android libera la ventana del juego al pasar a segundo plano, pero la superficie Vulkan seguía usándola y se destruía después. Ahora la superficie conserva su ventana hasta que se destruye.

### Reportes más útiles

- **El resumen del issue ya trae las líneas del juego.** Antes se tomaban de logcat y, cuando pulsabas *Reportar*, Android ya las había borrado: casi todos los issues llegaban con "últimas líneas del juego" vacío. Ahora salen del registro propio del juego (`game.log`), y logcat solo aporta las líneas del cierre.

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.13
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.13: mega actualización

Revisamos uno por uno los reportes y los zip de diagnóstico que nos enviaron. Esta versión corrige los fallos más repetidos y añade lo necesario para que los próximos reportes traigan toda la información.

### Gráficos

- **Detalle de las sombras ya se puede activar.** El juego solo habilita esa opción con tarjetas NVIDIA o ATI. Ahora el port se presenta como una NVIDIA GeForce 7800 GTX, así que la opción se puede subir y las sombras se dibujan en carrera.
- **Texturas DXT1 con transparencia correcta.** Se convierten a A1R5G5B5, como ya hace Carbon: menos memoria y bordes recortados correctos.
- **Protección para GPU PowerVR (MediaTek, p. ej. Moto g54 / Dimensity 7020).** El driver Vulkan de MediaTek se caía al crear el primer pipeline gráfico, en los cuatro juegos. Ahora, si el driver falla, el port reintenta con configuraciones más simples hasta encontrar una que funcione. *No hemos podido probarlo en un teléfono PowerVR; si tienes uno, cuéntanos cómo va.*

### Estabilidad

releases.name: 2.1 - November 18, 2026
releases.body: * **Start straight into a game (Wii).** Name a game when you launch DOSBox Wii and it starts with that game's config on top of `dosbox.conf`: from the Homebrew Channel (`<arguments>` in `meta.xml`) or from WiiFlow, either as a plugin (the zip now includes `wiiflow/plugins/dosbox-wii.ini`, which lists the `.conf` files in `DOSBox/Games` as games) or from its Homebrew list. A game can be named as `-gameconf <conf or folder>`, as a bare `.conf`, or as a bare folder that holds one (`autoboot.conf`, or its only `.conf`). A relative name is looked for as written, beside the launched `boot.dol`, then in the `DOSBox` folder, so a game's `.conf`, `.map` and files can all live in one folder, anywhere. If the game cannot be found DOSBox starts without one and says why on the DOS screen. The **Status** page has an **Autoboot** row, and the app now knows it was started this way (`IsAutoboot()`), ready for a single-game menu later. See the README's *Starting a game at launch*

This is a fun feature that has come about primarily because Windows on ARM mandates this feature. The [TPIDRRO_EL0](https://support.arm.com/documentation/ddi0601/2026-09/AArch64-Registers/TPIDRRO-EL0--EL0-Read-Only-Software-Thread-ID-Register?lang=en) register

contain the current CPU core index once read. This gives ARM64/ARM64ec applications a really quick way to read what core it is executing on. This is
kind of a funny thing that needs to exist because **technically** the MPIDR_EL1 register is supposed to accomplish the same task. Although this

releases.name: FEX Release FEX-2610
releases.body:
# Read the blog post at [FEX-Emu's Site!](https://fex-emu.com/FEX-2610/)
We were a bit distracted this month with the [X.Org Developer's Conference](https://indico.freedesktop.org/event/12/) happening but we still managed
to get some work done. Let's jump in and see what has changed.

## JIT changes
This month brought some improvements to the JIT although less than typical. We added support for AVX-VNNI which is starting to get used by some game
libraries. We also optimized the SSE4.2 string operations so these are quite a bit faster. 3DNow! has been enabled again since we fixed the last known
bug with it. We also improved emulation on the x87 FXAM instruction since apparently Mono uses it to detect denormals for some reason. Additionally a
peephole optimization to improve a common case of an unmasked AVX gather instruction which some sound libraries rely on.

We also now have a software fallback for RDRAND and RDSEED instructions. This isn't enabled by default as the performance isn't as good as a hardware
implementation but it's useful for programs that mandate these instructions to exist. Also useful for platforms with Qualcomm Oryon where their RNG

releases.name: FEX Release FEX-2609
releases.body:
# Read the blog post at [FEX-Emu's Site!](https://fex-emu.com/FEX-2609/)
**"Kept you waiting, huh?"** - Solid Snake, professional sneaky man.

We're not going to sugar coat it, this last month was very busy and time just kept moving faster than expected.
A ton of work landed this month so we're going to just need to pick some of the highlights. Let's hop in!

# Jit work you say?
A bunch of random bug fixes and performance improvements landed this month. Primary things here are that there were various behaviour fixes for some
instructions. Undefined and defined flag fixes that FEX was messing up, some deadlock fixes, handling more cases that were previously asserts. There
was an optimization for the PMULHRSW instruction family that increased some Geekbench benchmark numbers. Surely some game uses it somewhere to notice
the 2x perf uplift. We also made the "full" self-modifying-code detection faster, which is used for Unity games in some instances. So that's nice.
We also reduced some lock-contention in the JIT so multiple threads jitting code at the same time should block each other less frequently.

There's more of course but come on we gotta go!

# Removed hacky unixlib fallbacks

releases.name: FEX Release FEX-2608
releases.body:
# Read the blog post at [FEX-Emu's Site!](https://fex-emu.com/FEX-2608/)
After what felt like a very quick month, it's time for another FEX release. We're busy writing improvements for next month's release already, so let's
not distract for too long and smash through these changes!

## Removal of deprecated FEXInterpreter binary
Back in the [FEX-2510](/FEX-2510) release we completely removed a **FEXLoader** binary with a deprecation of the **FEXInterpreter** binary, renaming it to
just **FEX**. We kept the FEXInterpreter binary around for a while because downstream projects had hardcoded the binary in their scripts and we wanted to give
some time for them to migrate. After nearly a year we're hoping that everyone has migrated to the new binary name. If your project is still using the
old binary name then we recommend fix them!

## The typical JIT improvements
As typical there are a bunch of JIT changes this month. Let's breakdown  what was fixed.

- Use SVE XAR for SHA1 emulation as a minor optimization.
- Fix JIT telemetry value unconstrained predictable problem on ARMv8.0
  - Would only cause some missed telemetry on ARMv8.0 platforms, very minor.

# reNut Android 0.4.0

An experimental Android port of **Banjo-Kazooie: Nuts & Bolts** (Xbox 360), built from a static recompilation of the game.

> **Heads up:** this is a vibe-coded port. Expect bugs, rough edges and uneven compatibility across devices.

## Features

- **Local multiplayer** for two players: connect a second gamepad and it joins as player 2.
- **No GPU command-stream emulation.** The game's Direct3D calls are translated straight into Vulkan through Plume, the same renderer layer UnleashedRecomp uses, with shaders recompiled ahead of time. Some Xbox 360 GPU behaviour (resolves, texture formats, tessellation, memexport) is still emulated on the host.
- **In-app achievements** section.
- **Graphics options** to trade quality for performance:
  - internal resolution
  - texture resolution
  - shadow resolution
- **Adrenotools driver support**, a bundled Turnip driver and Turnip tuning options.
- **Save import and export.**

## Performance

On a Galaxy S23 Ultra the game runs above 30 FPS at the original graphics settings. Other devices have not been tested, so your results will vary. If it runs slowly, lower the internal, texture and shadow resolution.

releases.name: 0.1.7-alpha - 2026-11-13
releases.body:
### Fixed

- Ghost of Yōtei no longer freezes after its shaders are compiled (#3). Two causes:
  - Planning the resources of a shader walked the shader's whole value graph again for every word of every buffer descriptor; on this game's largest shaders that took minutes on the GPU command thread, with nothing submitted meanwhile. Each value is now walked once per shader.
  - A few compute shaders became SPIR-V modules of 2.7-3.2 million words that the GPU driver compiled for 15 minutes and more while the game waited (the driver keeps the result, so only the first run on a machine stalled). The largest is now 0.6 million words and builds in about 40 s on an RTX 5090, once; the results are the same, bit for bit (device tests over every buffer format, page-crossing elements and partial EXEC):

### Fixed

- Windows: controllers work out of the box. The release archive now carries `SDL3.dll`: the emulator loads SDL at run time and Windows has none of its own, so no controller was found ("SDL3 not available") unless the file was added by hand. releases.name: 1.0.5-alpha
releases.body:
### Changed

- The automatic choice of the recording thread (`RPS5E_GPU_RECORD_THREAD=auto`) no longer turns it off while the command interpreter also has to wait for room in its queue (`RPS5E_POLICY_FULL`). SILENT HILL: The Short Message's heavy room about 10 fps instead of 8; GTA V with `RPS5E_BDA=1` 47 fps instead of 42.
- `RPS5E_BDA=1` (experimental direct guest memory reads) no longer changes the default of `RPS5E_LABELS_AT_EOP`: with its old default (`1`) GTA V never left its start menu. GTA V's city in Performance mode with `RPS5E_BDA=1`: 47-48 fps against 37 without it; still off by default.
- The emulator's own small writes into GPU-watched guest memory (memcpy/memset inside one page, packets of the command-buffer builders) mark the page written before the store instead of taking a page fault (`RPS5E_PREMARK_SMALL`). GTA V's city in Performance mode: write faults per frame ~1550 → ~320; over the same stretch of the scene the frame rate rises by about 2.5 % (36.6 → 37.4 fps).

releases.name: 0.1.4-alpha
releases.body:
### Added

- On-screen keyboard for games' text input dialogs (sceImeDialog), drawn over the game: type on the keyboard (Enter accepts, Esc cancels) or use the controller (D-pad and Cross on the keys, Circle cancels, Triangle space, Square delete, L1 / R1 move the caret, L2 shift, R2 or Options accept), or click the keys. The game's pads read released while it is shown, and buttons still held when it (or the in-game menu) closes reach the game only after they are released. Before, the dialog was accepted at once with a default text (Demon's Souls' character name). Runs without a window, scripted runs and input recordings and replays still finish the dialog by themselves; `RPS5E_IME_HEADLESS=1` does so with a window too.

### Changed

releases.name: 0.1.3-alpha - 2026-10-31
releases.body:
### Fixed

- Frame captures (`RPS5E_CAPTURE_FRAMES`) of GTA V replay again instead of hanging the GPU. While a capture recorded, GPU results copied straight into guest memory were later taken for CPU writes and recorded; the replay wrote them over its own GPU results, which differ where GPU work orders its atomics differently, and the mixed ray-tracing tree sent a shader into an endless loop. GPU results now reach guest memory through copies the capture sees while it records.
- Silent Hill 2 (Remake) no longer hangs the GPU after START GAME. A small compute write (a 4-byte counter in reused transient memory) at an address where a render target once kept its fast-clear metadata was taken for a metadata clear, which overwrote the counter and left a GPU loop running for billions of iterations; only writes that cover a whole metadata slice count as clears now (`RPS5E_WHOLE_METADATA_WRITES`).

# Lichii-Enhanced v1.0.0: first public release

Lichii-Enhanced is a fork of [Lichii](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii) focused on usability: easier setup, built-in upscaling, non-destructive modding and more reliable online play. This is the first public release.

> **Platform:** Windows 10/11 x64 only. Distributed as a `.zip` archive. Other platforms are not available yet.

## Highlights

### 🖼️ Built-in upscalers
Upscaling is now part of the renderer; no external injectors or wrappers are needed.

- New post-process stage at the end of the Vulkan frame (compute shaders), running after game rendering and before swapchain presentation
- Filters: Nearest, Bilinear, Bicubic, FSR 1.0 (EASU + RCAS), SGSR
- Configurable render scale and sharpness (RCAS strength)
- Per-game profiles stored in `config/custom/<title-id>.ini`
- Optional anti-aliasing pass before upscaling

releases.name: TOTKDroid 0.3.4 (beta): sem queda depois do menu e geração de quadros melhor
releases.body:
**Beta 0.3.4.** Acaba a **queda de fps depois de fechar o inventário** ([#53](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/53), [#24](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/24)) e melhora a **geração de quadros (LSFG)**: importar o `Lossless.dll`, funcionar em mais GPUs Mali e pedir à tela a taxa de atualização que os quadros gerados precisam.

> **Nenhum arquivo do jogo vem junto.** Você precisa do seu próprio dump de *Tears of the Kingdom* com a atualização **1.4.3** aplicada (`exefs` e `romfs`, ou o `romfs` como um único `romfs.bin`).

Atualiza por cima das versões anteriores sem apagar os saves. **Não desinstale o app antes**: isso apaga os saves.

## O que mudou

- **Queda depois do menu ([#53](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/53), [#24](https://github.com/mamcjr/TOTKDroid/issues/24)):**
  - A queda de 12-14 s depois de fechar o inventário, de escolher uma arma ou de salvar não era o clock da GPU, como eu tinha dito.
  - O app desligava o "sync lag" por ~10 s sempre que o jogo saía do mundo, para proteger os carregamentos. Só que ele não distinguia um menu de uma tela de carregamento, e nesses segundos a CPU ficava esperando a GPU.

releases.name: TOTKDroid 0.3.3 (beta): FSR 1 e FXAA mais leves
releases.body:
**Beta 0.3.3.** O **FSR 1** e o **FXAA** ficaram mais leves para a GPU, com a mesma imagem.

> **Nenhum arquivo do jogo vem junto.** Você precisa do seu próprio dump de *Tears of the Kingdom* com a atualização **1.4.3** aplicada (`exefs` e `romfs`, ou o `romfs` como um único `romfs.bin`).

Atualiza por cima das versões anteriores sem apagar os saves. **Não desinstale o app antes**: isso apaga os saves.

## O que mudou

- **FSR 1 (EASU) na metade do tempo:**
  - A análise de borda roda uma vez por pixel, em vez de quatro.
  - Onde não há borda, o pixel sai direto da interpolação bilinear.
  - As contas de cor usam meia precisão, que vira fp16 onde o driver aceita.

Update type: major

## You choose how often you update

From now on there's one main release a week. Pick your channel in **Settings › Updates › Update channel**:

- **Stable** (default): the weekly release, plus critical fixes.
- **Hotfix**: also the small fixes between weekly releases, as soon as they're out.
- **Preview**: also early builds of bigger changes, about a week before Stable. They can break things, so pick this only if you want to help test.

The channel list shows which version each channel would give you right now. When you switch, you see the release notes before anything installs. Critical fixes reach every channel and are marked **Important fix**. A dot on the Settings button tells you an update is waiting.

releases.name: NeoST 0.6.3 — NetUSBee USB and built-in networking
releases.body:
## NeoST 0.6.3 — NetUSBee USB and built-in networking

- **NetUSBee USB devices:** connect a virtual USB keyboard, mouse or disk image
  to either port. Hot-plug devices in Configuration → Network, save them in
  profiles, or use `--usb1` / `--usb2` in the headless runner. USB4TOS drivers
  have been tested with keyboard input, mouse packets and file reads/writes.
  Disk images support read-only mounting. Native ST-side USB drivers are required.
- **Built-in NAT:** IPv4/IPv6 networking without libslirp or GLib, including
  DHCP, DNS, TCP/UDP and explicit port forwarding. STinG/ENEC can load HTTP pages.
- **Hardware accuracy:** further CPU, video, floppy, serial and sound fixes,
  backed by chip documentation and regression benches. Vroom Elite starts on STE.
- **Issue #44:** missing Atari ROMs are reported as skipped Spectrum 512 tests;
  available machines still detect regressions, and partial runs cannot overwrite
  the reference set.

**Save states use format v59. Older states cannot be loaded.** Disk image contents
remain external to save states. USB passthrough and isochronous transfers are not
implemented.

## NeoST 0.6.2 — closer to the metal

Seven weeks of hardware fidelity work since 0.6.1.

**Deterministic external control.** A `--server` mode, joystick scripts, memory probes

releases.body:
## NeoST 0.6.1 — your settings stay put

A patch release. No new features: **23 defects** found and fixed across five rounds of multi-agent bug hunting, plus a hardware-validation pass on the published packages.

### Settings are saved again

On macOS and on every AppImage, NeoST runs from **read-only media**, so it stores its configuration in your user directory — but it never created that directory, and every setting was silently lost when you closed the emulator. **Five of the eight packages were affected.** Machine profile, video, audio and MIDI setup now survive a restart.

### Also fixed

- **The macOS disk image installs by drag and drop.** It shipped with the app alone, no `Applications` shortcut.
- **The web build ships its licences** (GPL-3.0, GPL-2.0, third-party notices), like every other package.
- **A save-state can no longer be reloaded under a different ROM.** The pairing relied on two bytes of TOS version, which five localisations share, so resuming under the wrong ROM froze the CPU without a word. The state format is now **v19**; v18 and older are refused explicitly, with a message that says why.

Frostpunk for Android 0.3.1-dev fixes crashes triggered by some achievements and events, improves native Vulkan and PanVK compatibility, and expands launcher localization and crash reporting.

## Gameplay and stability

- Fix a crash triggered by achievement and event names containing a colon, including `Endless: Backup Plan`. The offline Steam bridge now handles those names and returns errors for individual rejected storage operations.
- Fix parsing of numbered save names such as `Name-3`. Add Win64 runtime support for wide-string integer parsing, numeric conversions and C++ exception-message handling.
- Handle requests for the offline Steam store overlay and external menu links without launching a browser.

## Rendering and touch controls

- Extend experimental Native Vulkan (PanVK) and DXVK (PanVK) checks to Mali and Immortalis devices on Android 11 or newer. Bundled PanVK requires 4 KiB kernel pages. Devices with other page sizes can import a compatible driver and run the launcher check.
- Restore missing ground snow when starting a new game in native Vulkan by correcting how the renderer caches texture bindings.

Experimental Android ARM64 update focused on memory controls, graphics settings, driver management, and crash diagnostics.

## Changes

- Add Auto, Normal, Reduced, and Minimum memory modes. Automatic selection adapts to available device RAM without overwriting saved graphics preferences.
- Show a one-time low-memory warning when Android reports 7.5 GiB of RAM or less.
- Add model detail and building model quality controls, with both defaulting to their lowest levels. Existing saved choices are preserved.
- Improve geometry simplification and graphics profile handling, and show output resolution in pixels and percentages.
- Restore normal city updates and rendering while paused by removing forced update suppression and frozen-frame reuse.
- Support landscape and reverse landscape only, including gamepad attachment and the crash monitor.
- Bundle one shared purple-turnip T30 driver for GPU checks and gameplay, with Mesa license text and driver provenance included.

Launcher compatibility update for Frostpunk for Android.

## Changes

- Keep the launcher usable when the device or selected renderer cannot run the game.

- Preserve renderer selection and the compatibility checks that guard game startup.

Download **Frostpunk-0.1.1-dev.apk** and its **.sha256** file from the assets below.

releases.name: hakuX 1.3.0
releases.body:
Xbox Live through Insignia, and game fixes.

### Xbox Live
- **Insignia** — Settings → Network → Connection → Xbox Live: Insignia connects the console to Insignia, the revival of the original Xbox Live: Live games sign in, find matches and play online. If your Internet provider blocks Insignia's DNS server, point it at a computer running insigniaDNS instead
- **Xbox Live setup** — Settings → Network → Xbox Live setup walks you through it, one step at a time: the connection, the Xbox dashboard, registering the console with Insignia's Setup Assistant (downloaded for you), then making or recovering your account in the dashboard
- **Dashboard** — the library's Dashboard button (top left) starts the Xbox dashboard from the console's hard disk, where Xbox Live accounts are made and recovered. The first time, it installs the dashboard from a zip of its files (dashboard 5960) that you provide: hakuX doesn't include one
- **Title updates** — a game's Xbox Live update, once downloaded, starts with the game. Forza Motorsport's 60 and 120 fps mods cover its update too

### Games
- **Fable: The Lost Chapters** — the hero's face and arms are no longer black or noise

releases.name: hakuX 1.2.0
releases.body:
System link, stability and compatibility improvements.

### Network
- **System link over your network** — Settings → Network → System link → LAN: hakuX devices on the same Wi-Fi network find each other as Xbox consoles on a LAN do. Devices the network's broadcasts don't reach, on another subnet or a VPN such as ZeroTier or Tailscale, are added by address under Other consoles
- **XLink Kai** — system link over the Internet through an XLink Kai engine running on a computer on your network; its web page picks the game's arena
- **Console identity** — each console has its own serial number, network address and online key. A device whose hard disk was copied from another one offers to make itself a new identity, since two consoles with one identity can't see each other


### Games
- **Sega GT 2002** — the cars have their paint, reflections and sun highlights
- **Doom 3** — no longer crashes as its main menu loads
- **Fatal Frame II** — starts and reads its disc in the order it asks for
- **AirForce Delta Storm** — answers the controller and the on-screen controls (it ignored all input)
- **Silent Hill 2** — no longer crashes when it loads a room

releases.name: hakuX 1.1.0
releases.body:
GPUs beyond Adreno (experimental).

### GPUs
- **Mali, Xclipse and PowerVR (experimental)** — hakuX runs on GPUs other than Adreno: features they lack are replaced (BC and 4444 textures decoded up front, standard border colours, the push block in a buffer, D32S8 depth), and known driver bugs are worked around (`hw/xbox/hle/vk/quirks.c`). Burnout 3 and Mercenaries run cleanly on a Pixel 8 (Mali-G715)
- **Vulkan 1.1 drivers** — GPUs whose drivers stop at Vulkan 1.1 (Valhall Mali on older or vendor-capped drivers, Qualcomm's own older drivers, early Xclipse, PowerVR BXM) run through a compatibility layer (`hw/xbox/hle/vk/compat.c`)
- **Older GPUs without descriptor indexing (experimental)** — Bifrost Mali (G71, G72, G76, G52) and PowerVR Rogue: each draw binds its own textures, and depth is clamped in the shader where the GPU can't
- **Adreno** — unchanged: every replacement is off where the GPU has the feature.

### App
- **GPU driver** — a screen of its own (Settings → GPU driver): the system driver and the stored packages in one list, with their versions and authors. Packages are checked when added and can be deleted (deleting the one in use goes back to the system driver)

releases.name: hakuX 1.0.0
releases.body:
A new core replaces xemu's QEMU-based one.

### New core
- **CPU** — the Xbox's x86 code runs on a FEX JIT (FEXCore fork), and the Xbox kernel is reimplemented natively (`native/kernel`): no QEMU
- **GPU** — the NV2A push buffer is decoded into Vulkan (HLE, `hw/xbox/hle`). Custom drivers (Turnip) load through adrenotools; driver-specific workarounds are quirks (`hw/xbox/hle/vk/quirks.c`, `debug.hakux.quirks`)
- **Audio** — the MCPX APU runs on the core's own services (`native/dev/apu`), out through AAudio
- **Savestates** — per game, in slots, with the hard disk's files
- **Mods and cheats** — per game, from `mods/` (library long-press "Mods & cheats"): XBE patches and replaced disc files; 60 and 120 fps mods for 13 games (`mods/README.md`, generators in `tools/mods`)
- **Controllers** — each physical controller routed to a player with its own mapping; the on-screen controller adds to player 1

### New features
- **Updates** — hakuX looks for a newer release on GitHub when it starts and on demand (Settings → Updates); one found shows its notes and installs from there
- **Frontends** — a game launched from ES-DE or another frontend returns to it when it closes

# SeedlessDS 1.1 正式版

版本名为 `1.1`，版本号为 `153`。本次同时发布原包名替换版、共存版、对应源码及 SHA-256 校验文件。两版均关闭 Android 调试标志，正式版本号与发布文件名均不含 debug，测试控制面板关闭。

## 本次改进

- 修复后台存档提前完成时，完成状态被模拟线程覆盖，导致后续快速存档和读档一直被忽略的问题。
- 减少存读档结束后的多余槽位查询、成就附加档读取和目录扫描，成就校验改为流式 SHA-256。
- 拆分即时存档、游戏电池存档和其它文件的访问锁，避免后台慢存档连带阻塞游戏文件读取。后台存档线程降低优先级。
- 防止并发慢查询重新发布已失效的目录列表，修复日志时间格式化的并发访问。
- 在应用私有目录保留有大小上限的近期存读档记录，便于追查偶发卡顿。
- 保留 SoundTouch 原声音高加速、低延迟音频恢复修复，以及按 RP Duo 上下屏实际画面尺寸适配的柔和颗粒、柔和颗粒＋和 Nova 磷光点滤镜。

## 安装包选择

| 文件 | Android 包名 | 安装方式 |
|---|---|---|
| `seedless-ds-1.1-coexist.apk` | `com.seedlessds.app.debug` | 可直接更新本分支旧共存版，也可与官方版共存 |
| `seedless-ds-1.1-replacement.apk` | `com.seedlessds.app` | 原包名替换版 |

| `seedless-ds-1.1-SHA256.txt` | — | 安装包和源码校验值 |

替换版与官方版签名不同。首次换用替换版，请先导出存档与配置，再卸载官方版并安装。直接覆盖官方版会因签名不匹配而失败。两个包名的数据各自独立，切换使用时需导入存档。

两版均支持 ARM64，最低 Android 5.0。证书 SHA-256 为 `99e2395bd7c458a577e6bc4f4c7237a7474cb20a178fad07313c2778a7943165`，沿用仓库随源公开测试签名。

## 验证范围

- 两种正式构建各 128 项应用测试通过，完成构建、Lint、包名和签名检查，并核对 `debuggable=false`、`testOnly=false` 及 `BuildConfig.DEBUG=false`。两版的应用资源和原生库一致。

releases.name: Termux-Aether 1000.0.0
releases.body:
## Pacman suite (packaging revision 2)

Download **`termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz`** and its `.sha256` file. This is a real Pacman package:

```sh
sha256sum -c termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz.sha256
pacman -U ./termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz
```

It directly owns the native runtime and API commands and stages both APKs under `$PREFIX/share/termux-aether-suite`. Update Android apps using `aether-apks api`, then `aether-apks app`; Android confirms these updates. Existing app IDs, signatures and data paths are preserved. Shizuku and Arch images remain optional.

If you previously installed Aether commands manually, download `aether-install.py` and its checksum too:

```sh
sha256sum -c aether-install.py.sha256
python aether-install.py --adopt-legacy ./termux-aether-suite-aarch64.pkg.tar.xz
```

This backs up only the nine known unowned legacy commands and transfers ownership to Pacman. Unrelated files/packages are refused. No wildcard overwrite or editing of checksum-protected scripts is needed. Use `aether-update` for later protected upgrades, or install new suite packages with `pacman -U` directly.

releases.body:
Coffee GB 2.1.6 adds BESS save-state interchange, expands Game Boy peripheral support, and brings connection choices and device controls together in the desktop menu.

## Changes

- Load and save BESS-compatible states from the File menu, with validated ROM matching and interchange for supported DMG, CGB, and SGB configurations.
- Use HuC-1/HuC-3 cartridge infrared and send or receive GBKiss GBF files.
- Scan EAN-13 barcodes with the separate Barcode Taisen Bardigun reader.
- Run Pocket Sonar with MBC1S sensor emulation and simulated sonar input. Scene changes now end active input recording, and the mapper is included in state coverage checks.
- Use Turbo File GB internal memory and removable cards, including import/export, persistence, and write protection. The GBA-only Advance choice is no longer exposed in the menu; legacy state and storage support is retained.

- Organize Peripherals into Link port, Cartridge, and Infrared. Device submenus combine Connect with their controls; Mobile Adapter configuration moves from Preferences into its device submenu.

- **Problem:** When entering some cities, the game would crash and close.

- **Problem:** Monsters only attacked when the HOST was nearby. If only the CLIENT approached, the monster would remain still.
- **Fix:** Detection now compares the HOST and all CLIENTs present on the same map and returns the **closest** to the monster as the target.

### 🐛 Bug: Incorrect monster level scaling in co-op
- **Problem:** Monsters scaled based on 0+ (extra players). × 2), resulting in level 2 Goblins in a session with 2
- **Correction:** Now uses the Bestiary's `minlevel` as a base before applying the LAN difficulty multiplier. Example: Goblin (base level 4) + 2 players = level 6. Yeti (base level 18) + 2 players = level 22.

### 🐛 Bug: CLIENT couldn't reduce HOST's HP in the PVP Arena

## English

**S2Arm on Windows can build D2R-Mobile.** Packing no longer needs a C compiler, the .NET SDK or a separately installed spirv-cross: the shell now carries everything prebuilt for Mac and Windows (the shader translator as a NativeAOT single file, the texture deswizzle library, and spirv-cross built from upstream vulkan-sdk-1.4.363.0 as is). A machine with only S2Arm installed can pack. On Windows, shaders go into the package as source and are compiled on the phone at first launch.

| Asset | For |
|---|---|
| `D2RMobile-s2arm-bundle.zip` | What S2Arm downloads: the 2.3.3 source and the iOS 26 shell with the prebuilt tools. Not for manual use |
| `D2RMobile-shell-build-input.zip` | New iOS 26 shell ([NO_XCODE.md](docs/NO_XCODE.md)). Build input, not installable |

releases.name: Xenoblade 3 port v0.4.0
releases.body:
## No more blinking objects after loading

While the game is running, each new combination of shader and render state needs a GPU pipeline. Pipelines the app has never seen are built in the background so the game doesn't freeze, and until one is ready the objects that use it are not drawn. Until now that also happened to pipelines it had already built in an earlier session. Only the first 4,000 were prepared at start-up, in the order they first appeared, so later in the game whole areas came from the background again. The result was objects and textures blinking for a few frames after loading a save or when walking into an area.

- Pipelines that the app has already built on your device are now created on the spot, in about a quarter of a millisecond each and within a small per-frame budget, so they are drawn from the first frame.
- Start-up preparation now begins with the pipelines your last session used (`pipelines_recientes.bin` in the game folder), not with the ones from the beginning of the game.
- Areas you visit for the very first time can still show an object a moment late while its pipeline is built. The second visit is clean.

Ahora el juego va en modo inmersivo: las dos barras se ocultan y deslizando desde un borde salen un momento. Comprobado en la Flip 2.

releases.body:
## Save report and update notices

Two new rows in the settings panel (swipe in from the right edge of the screen):

- **Save report** writes a folder `reports/<date>/` into your game folder: the log, a screenshot of the moment you opened the panel, the frame times of the last seconds and basic device information (model, Android version, memory). **Nothing is sent anywhere.** If something looks wrong, open an [issue](https://github.com/IamWilmar/xenoblade3-recomp/issues) and attach those files (have a look first: the log contains the names of your folders).
- **Update notices** (on by default): about eight seconds after the game starts, the app asks GitHub's public API which release is the latest. It is a single request, without an account, and nothing about you or your game is sent. If there is a newer version, a banner says so and *Get vX.Y.Z* opens its page. Switch it off in the panel (or create an empty file `sin_avisos_version` in the game folder) and the app makes no network request at all.
- Because of the update notices the app now has Android's **Internet** permission. It is used for that request only.

## Installing

releases.name: 宝可梦传说 Z-A · Mali 零拷贝修复（3→30 FPS）
releases.body:
# 宝可梦传说 Z‑A 安卓移植 · Mali 零拷贝修复版（宿主 APK）

**这是一个“宿主”APK：只含移植运行时，不含任何游戏数据、NSO、资源或密钥。**
运行它需要你**自备自己游戏卡带/数字版的转储**，并用 [nx2android](https://github.com/shirai91/nx2android)
的 porter 生成数据包（步骤见仓库 README 的「怎么用」与「自备文件与公开性」）。

## 这版修了什么（Mali‑G925 上 3 FPS → 30 FPS）

- **根因**：MTK（MT6991）的 gralloc 给 `AHardwareBuffer` 的 native handle 有 3 个 fd，
  `fd[0]` 是 size 0 的只读元数据文件，`fd[1]` 才是 dma-buf（`st_size == 缓冲区大小`）。
  上游恒取 `fds[0]` 去 `mmap`，于是这台 Mali 上 771 MB 的 NVN 内存池**全部**退回
  “每提交整池双向 memcpy”，每帧约 375 ms——这正是帧时间的大头。
- **修法**：`ahb_buf_fd()` 按 `fstat().st_size == 池大小` 选出真正的 dma-buf fd；
  `pool_zero_copy()` 与 `vk_pool_remap_ro()` 都改用它。补丁全文：
  [`patches/nx2android/local-patches-2026-11-04.patch`](https://github.com/Timqt/pokelegza-and/blob/main/patches/nx2android/local-patches-2026-11-04.patch)
- **实测**（25079RPDCC，Dimensity 9400 级，Mali‑G925‑Immortalis MC12，Vulkan 1.3.278）：

| | 修复前 | 修复后 |
|---|---|---|
| 零拷贝内存池 | 0 / 771 MB | **771.2 / 771.2 MB** |
| 菜单 FPS | 2–3 | **30**（游戏自身 present interval 上限） |
| 帧工作 p50 | 343 ms | **16.9 ms** |
| submit+present | 53–82 ms | 3–4.5 ms |

- 已能从语言选择一路进到开场列车场景（字幕 “Your train has arrived in Lumiose
  City!”）。当前瓶颈是 GPU 渲染（场景内约 20–25 ms，≈48 FPS 上限）。

## 使用
